name: Specialized Switchgear Solutions LLC
old_description: , we specialize in the design, manufacturing, and service of high-quality switchgear solutions. From custom builds to maintenance and retrofits, we deliver reliable power distribution systems that keep your business running safely and efficiently.
about:
Specialized Switchgear Solutions operates from Mansfield, Ohio. The company was formed by Rick Knox and Donald Smith after the February 2020 closure of PACS Switchgear, where both had spent decades advancing through production, quality, and management roles. Knox, a Six Sigma Blackbelt, had overseen manufacturing operations with up to 400 employees, while Smith led special projects, field service, and parts management. Their combined experience spans assembly, design, quality assurance, and customer support across medium‑voltage switchgear.

The firm designs, manufactures, and services custom switchgear assemblies, including circuit breakers, switches, potential transformer drawers, and ground‑and‑test devices. It handles new builds, maintenance programs, and retrofits for power distribution systems, backed by a team of engineers, technicians, and project specialists. Quality assurance follows tested protocols, and lean manufacturing principles guide production, though facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

Customers include industrial and commercial facilities that require reliable medium‑voltage power distribution. The company’s work covers custom component fabrication, spare‑parts supply, and on‑site field service for installation and maintenance. No specific end‑user sectors are named beyond the switchgear industry itself.

The founders emphasize safety‑first engineering to the highest industry standards, precision manufacturing with verified quality checks, and a service commitment that extends beyond delivery. The venture was launched to continue the switchgear expertise they built at PACS and to maintain long‑term client relationships after that company’s shutdown.
